==About==

An {{i|Angel-Winged Seabass}} can be dried on a {{i|Drying Frame}} for 72 hours to make a {{i|Dried Angel-Winged Seabass}}. Due to the current nature of the most recent Fish rework there is no reason to ever make a Dried Angel-Winged Seabass.
